parsed.explanation: No documented traveller-facing trans-specific restriction: the dossier records no border, facility, custody or ward rule, though it explicitly says border and screening practice is unsourced and not to be inferred either way. Same-sex conduct is legal, and foreign-recognised identity has been ordered transcribed by courts (2024 ruling; March 2026 order), a positive for document acceptance. Against this, official rhetoric targets gender markers, a Pride ban was attempted, and anti-discrimination and hate-crime protections do not name gender identity, with follow-through described as limited. Trans-specific violence and discrimination prevalence are unquantified. Given the documented hostile rhetoric, weak enforcement and missing trans-specific protection, but no documented visitor-facing exposure, this sits in the reduced-risk band, below comparable protective jurisdictions.
